free_tier_limits: Free Music API (€0): public free test key; restricted methods/result counts on many V1 endpoints vs premium. Free rate limit 30 req/min. Premium unlocks fuller V1 methods and V2 API access.
paid_plans: Single Developer €8/month (premium V1 methods, higher limits, MusicBrainz lookups, music videos). Small Business €20/month (120 req/min, social links, dedicated support, private key). Lifetime options also listed on pricing page.
rate_limits: Free: 30 requests/minute; Premium: 100/minute; Business: 120/minute. Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429; wait about one minute before retrying.
resolution_notes: pricing: auditor correct.
